| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smoothing h** `h` | 2 | 0.5 to 5 | The global smoothing parameter h of the kernel. 2.0 as in the paper's experiments on JPEG artifacts and film grain. |
| **Regression order N** `order` | 2 (local quadratic) | 0 (weighted average), 1 (local plane), 2 (local quadratic) | The order of the local polynomial. The paper's denoising experiments use 2. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 3 | 1 to 10 | How many times the kernels are estimated again and the regression repeated. The paper uses 3 for real noise and 7 for strong Gaussian noise. |
| **Window radius** `radius` | 5 | 2 to 8 px | The regression window is 2 radius + 1 pixels on each side. Our choice of 5, since the paper does not give its window. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Each channel separately, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
